sampling: Seeded12families per split, one source state per family; candidate identity fixed by generator and allfour radii, never by physical outcomes. Original endpoint images and physical labels reused. No test access.
noise: One fixed spatial Gaussian noise field shared by nominal/modified endpoint images within each state and amplitude, so appearance is held constant in the physical-pair contrast. Independent perframe noise and future dynamics are outside this diagnostic.
contrasts: Clean physical pair, corrupted physical pair, nominal appearance-only pair, and combined physical+appearance change relative to clean nominal. A transformed image never changes the saved physical label. No retraining or predictor activation intervention.
scope: F4 representation/readout diagnostic subset. Synthetic observation shifts only; not physical counterfactual dynamics or deployment preservation evidence. Any changed representation needs later F8/F9 selection evaluation. Background mask uses exactwhite rendered pixels; known-renderer diagnostic.
